prompt:
Create ONE production 2D hand-painted game terrain asset on a genuinely transparent background, based on the attached underwater whale-interior reference and current game screenshot. References are STYLE AND MATERIAL only; the screenshot's ugly mushroom-headed hanging pillars are expressly REJECTED, do not copy them.
Asset: an asymmetrical vertical WHALE JAW-BONE RIFT / hanging skeletal cliff rib, not a man-made column. Portrait about 1000 x 1800 composition. Organic broad flowing lamellar bone planes, worn ivory-grey edges, desaturated blue-grey shadows, subtle coral-pink old tissue seams, sparse barnacles bonded close to the surface. Painted in the same rich but controlled brush style as the reference. It should read as a section of a huge whale's inner jaw/roof splitting downward, with a continuous rough silhouette and only shallow rounded erosion at the lower end. No big horizontal cap, flange, mushroom brim, platform shelf, flat rectangular slab, straight square cut ends, long pointed taper, spikes or root fingers.
Physical usability: a generous contiguous OPAQUE central mass approximately the inner 65% of the visible body's width and inner 85% of its height. Interior cavities are painted shadow depressions, NEVER transparent windows through the solid central mass. Side contour may meander gently around that solid core. Top shoulders must vary in height and lean, without a T-shape; bottom remains broad and gently broken, not a needle. Texture scale is medium, not rows of repeated honeycomb holes. Subtle light from upper left, matte wet bone, no white studio rim and no glow.
Only this one terrain piece, with at least 7% transparent padding on every side. No water backdrop, scenery, floor, cast shadow, UI, lettering, arrows, characters, gates, fish or extra independent objects. Whole silhouette contained in canvas.
